    // The smallest box containing both operands (component-wise Min of mins, Max of
    // maxs). Union with Empty() returns the other operand unchanged.
    Union(self: Bounds2D, other: Bounds2D): Bounds2D
        => (Point2D(self.Min.X.Min(other.Min.X), self.Min.Y.Min(other.Min.Y)),
            Point2D(self.Max.X.Max(other.Max.X), self.Max.Y.Max(other.Max.Y)));
```

    // The box grown to also contain `p` (the grow-from-Empty accumulation step).
    Union(self: Bounds2D, p: Point2D): Bounds2D
        => (Point2D(self.Min.X.Min(p.X), self.Min.Y.Min(p.Y)),
            Point2D(self.Max.X.Max(p.X), self.Max.Y.Max(p.Y)));
```

## Line 242

```plato

    // The smallest interval containing both operands (the convex hull of the two).
    // Forward orientation: start at the lesser start, end at the greater end.
    Union(self: IInterval<$T>, other: IInterval<$T>): Self
        => (self.Start.Lesser(other.Start), self.End.Greater(other.End));
```
